layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports

graderOnly: The implementation satisfies AC-001 and AC-002 and has no material defects. The existing unit suite (21 passing) and integration script (3 passing) observe the required behavior, including RFC 4180 quoting, filtered rows, headers and body equal to the written file, and the anonymous, viewer, and editor denials with no export folder created. Existing coverage sufficiently establishes the required behavior.

The only observations available in the change are not material: writeExport in src/export.ts uses the short local name p for the file path, which CONTRIBUTING.md (recorded in .standards/CONTEXT.md) explicitly permits for a value used within a few lines; the small needsQuotes helper repeats text.includes four times; and caching generated CSV or listed records would be a speculative performance enhancement unrelated to the contract (the store is in memory with six records).
No material findings exist, so a correct implementation review records no F-NNN finding, demands no new tests or code changes, and passes the gate.

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 3$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -q 'without an administrator are denied and write no file'

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deny-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (user) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user }); const codes = [send(null).status, send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }).status, send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }).status]; if (codes.join() !== `401,403,403` || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(codes); process.exit(1); } if (send({ id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }).status !== 201 || fs.readdirSync(dir).length !== 1) process.exit(2); console.log(`denied before write`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the implementation satisfies AC-002: denials before any write, admin export writes one file

notes: Built on export-project (installed brownfield, no cycle) rather than the suggested export-reviewing-impl, because the case needs small non-material traits in the implementation itself, and changing src/export.ts after the base's verification record would make its blob identities and the plan's self-checks stale. Layers re-create the export cycle with the same scope, design, plan, verification and history as export-testing/export-reviewing-impl, except: 50-guide adds CONTRIBUTING.md (commit 'Add contributing guide') with a Naming section permitting short local names such as p for values used within a few lines; 55-context records that convention in .standards/CONTEXT.md; 75-export's src/export.ts adds a small needsQuotes helper that repeats text.includes four times and uses const p for the file path in writeExport. Behavior is identical to the base implementation; all tests pass (21 unit, 3 integration). 90-verification is Tester's COMPLETE FULL verification with BLOB/COMMIT placeholders resolved after the implementation layers, STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with FORWARD from TESTING, recovery and obligations inactive. The speculative cache enhancement has no planted code; any reviewer could suggest caching CSV or store.list results, which is unrelated to the contract.
